start.title: Weggehen
start.text:
Du und dein Freund verlassen die Stadt.
Die Hoffnung ist an einem römischen Kreuz gestorben.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Despair is not the last word.

argue_consequence.title: Nicht verlassen
argue_consequence.text:
Trauer spricht laut, aber höre zu.
Geh weiter. Der Weg ist noch nicht zu Ende.

boast_consequence.title: Nicht Stolz
boast_consequence.text:
Niemand hat diesen Morgen vorhergesehen.
Geh einfach. Trage den Kummer.

stranger_joins.title: Ein stiller Reisender
stranger_joins.text:
Ein Fremder gesellt sich zu dir.
„Worüber sprecht ihr?“, fragt er.

refuse_consequence.title: Begrüße ihn
refuse_consequence.text:
Ein geteilter Weg ist halbierte Trauer.
Sprich. Der Fremde hört zu.

mock_consequence.title: Nicht Spott
mock_consequence.text:
Er hat freundlich gefragt.
Antworte ihm freundlich.

share_grief.title: Betreffend Jesus
share_grief.text:
„Er war ein Prophet, mächtig in Worten.
Sie kreuzigten ihn. Wir hatten gehofft…“

choices.text: [TODO:de] Blame the women for the rumor
[TODO:de] Cut the story short in shame
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Tell it whole. He is listening.

blame_consequence.title: Gib nicht die Schuld
blame_consequence.text:
Die Frauen trugen nur, was sie sahen.
Erzähle die ganze Geschichte.

short_consequence.title: Erzähle alles
short_consequence.text:
Verbirg nichts vor diesem Fremden.
Er ist präsenter, als du weißt.

scripture.title: [TODO:de] Foolish and Slow
scripture.text:
[TODO:de] "Did the Christ not have to suffer
and so enter into His glory?"

offense_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Not Offense
offense_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] His sharpness is the surgeon's blade.
Receive it. It is healing you.

interrupt_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Be Still
interrupt_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] You do not yet see what he sees.
Let him finish. Then you will know.

burning_hearts.title: [TODO:de] Hearts Aflame
burning_hearts.text:
[TODO:de] Something kindles inside your chest.
You cannot name it, but it burns.

distrust_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Trust the Fire
distrust_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Your heart knows before your mind.
Let it lead you forward.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Not Demand
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Heaven does not yield to demand.
Receive softly. Be carried.

invite_stay.title: [TODO:de] Emmaus Village
invite_stay.text:
[TODO:de] The village nears. He acts as if to go on.
The sun sinks low.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] He turns and follows you in.

letgo_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Do Not Lose Him
letgo_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Some moments must be held.
Call him back. Beg him to stay.

charge_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Not for Price
charge_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] A guest is welcomed, not sold to.
Open your door freely.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You set the table for three.

breaking_bread.title: [TODO:de] He Took the Bread
breaking_bread.text:
[TODO:de] He takes the bread. Blesses it.
Breaks it. Hands it to you.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Look at His hands. See Him.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] This is no time for pride.

look_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Lift Your Eyes
look_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Do not miss this for hunger.
The Guest is the Lord.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Look at His hands. See Him.

host_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Not Pride
host_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] Your bread became His blessing.
Look. Receive. Be still.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Look at His hands. See Him.

recognition.title: [TODO:de] He Vanishes
recognition.text:
[TODO:de] It is the Lord! Your eyes are opened.
And then He is gone.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Sit stunned and stay the night
[TODO:de] Rise at once. Run to Jerusalem

stay_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Do Not Wait
stay_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] The night is no obstacle now.
Go. The eleven must hear.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Rise at once. Run to Jerusalem

whisper_consequence.title: [TODO:de] Tell Them All
whisper_consequence.text:
[TODO:de] This is not a secret to keep.
Let the city hear, "He lives!"

choices.text: [TODO:de] Rise at once. Run to Jerusalem
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You set out into the dusk.

ending.title: [TODO:de] He Is Risen Indeed
ending.text:
[TODO:de] You burst in: "The Lord is risen!
He broke bread with us tonight."
